title: C4 integrated four-arm evaluation - design-only sketch (no outcomes)
researchQuestion: U-RQ: once every evidence gate opens, how does the governed end-to-end process compare with AI-only, human-only, and ordinary human-in-the-loop configurations over identical frozen inputs at a matched attention budget, on preregistered outcomes?
prerequisites: EXP-005 reaches at least 20 generalization-safe labels (currently 0/24)
Recruited reviewers, raters, and an independent implementer
Supervisor-approved four-arm protocol with frozen preregistration
Frozen fixtures, metric definitions, and matched attention budget
approvalGates: Supervisor approval recorded before any arm runs
Ethics and consent approval for human participation
Preregistration frozen before any outcome is inspected

arms.description: Automated judgment with no human review at any point; the automation-only reference condition.
Human judgment with no automated support; the human-only reference condition.
Conventional human-in-the-loop review without the governed-judgment contract, gates, or receipts.
The full governed process: selective-intervention policy, governed-judgment records, and controlled reuse gates operating together.

acceptanceRules: Design only: this definition authorizes no run and computes no outcome.
All four arms must be evaluated over identical frozen inputs at one matched attention budget.
Outcome metrics may be attached only after preregistration is frozen and the evidence gates above are open.
claimBoundary: Design-only sketch of the C4 four-arm evaluation. No arm has been run and no outcome exists; EXP-005 is 0/24 generalization-safe labels, so no accuracy, effort, capture, or generalization claim is made or permitted by this record.
validityThreats: Budget mismatch across arms breaking comparability
Outcome switching after inspection without preregistration
nextAction: Hold as a design sketch until EXP-005 reaches at least 20 generalization-safe labels and the supervisor approves the four-arm protocol.
